title: Skill
description: A versioned, governed capability that an agent or workflow node can invoke. Skills are immutable per (skill_id, version) and bundle their invocation triggers, machine-readable input/output contracts, required tools, and policy tags so agents can call them without copying prompt text. Canonical shape from the Synapse design report; drives the skill registry, its Postgres tables, and the OpenAPI surface.

skill_id.description: Stable logical identifier for the skill, unique within a tenant (e.g. "skill.approval.draft_response"). Combined with `version` it forms the immutable primary key.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill revision. A given (skill_id, version) pair is immutable once registered; new behavior must be published under a new version.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the skill.

summary.description: Short natural-language description of what the skill does, used for discovery and routing.

owners.description: Teams or principals responsible for the skill's definition and maintenance.

triggers.description: Natural-language intents or events that should surface / route to this skill.

input_schema.description: A nested JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing and validating the skill's accepted input arguments.

output_schema.description: A nested JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing and validating the skill's produced output.

required_tools.description: Tool/connector ids (resolved via the MCP gateway) that the skill depends on to run.

policy_tags.description: Policy labels evaluated by the Policy & Access Gateway (e.g. scopes, or `human_approval_required` before autonomous writes).

examples.description: Illustrative input/output pairs used for documentation and evaluation sets.
